result.instructions: Tools for Zadarma, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What is my Zadarma balance, and what is my current price plan?"; "Which SIP numbers on my account are online right now?"; "How much does a call to +44 20 3769 1880 cost on my plan?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Zadarma data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run zadarma_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run zadarma_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run zadarma_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. zadarma_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: zadarma_get_balance
tools.title: Get account balance
tools.description: Get the current account balance and its currency. Good first call to check the account works. Zadarma API: GET /v1/info/balance/.

tools.name: zadarma_get_tariff
tools.title: Get price plan
tools.description: Get the account's current price plan (tariff). Zadarma API: GET /v1/tariff/.

tools.name: zadarma_get_call_price
tools.title: Get call rate for a number
tools.description: Get the per-minute call rate in the account's price plan for one phone number (destination, prefix and currency). Zadarma API: GET /v1/info/price/.

number.description: Destination phone number, digits with country code, e.g. 442037691880.

annotations.title: Get call rate for a number

tools.name: zadarma_list_sip_numbers
tools.title: List SIP numbers
tools.description: List the SIP numbers (IDs, names and status) on the account. Zadarma API: GET /v1/sip/.

tools.name: zadarma_get_sip_status
tools.title: Get SIP number status
tools.description: Check whether one SIP number is online. Zadarma API: GET /v1/sip/{sip}/status/.

sip.description: SIP number ID, e.g. 00001 (padded to 5 digits).

tools.name: zadarma_list_pbx_extensions
tools.title: List PBX extensions
tools.description: List the extensions of the cloud PBX (number, name and settings). Zadarma API: GET /v1/pbx/internal/.

tools.name: zadarma_get_pbx_extension_status
tools.title: Get PBX extension status
tools.description: Check whether one PBX extension is online. Zadarma API: GET /v1/pbx/internal/{pbxsip}/status/.

tools.name: zadarma_list_virtual_numbers
tools.title: List virtual numbers
tools.description: List the virtual (direct) phone numbers rented on the account. Zadarma API: GET /v1/direct_numbers/.

tools.name: zadarma_get_call_statistics
tools.title: Get call statistics
tools.description: Get the call log for a period, optionally for one SIP number. Limited to 3 calls per minute per user: do not poll it. For live PBX data, use webhooks instead. Zadarma API: GET /v1/statistics/.

sip.description: Only calls on this SIP number ID.

tools.name: zadarma_get_call_recording_link
tools.title: Get call recording link
tools.description: Get a temporary download link for a call recording. Give the call_id (from the recording file name) or the pbx_call_id. Zadarma API: GET /v1/pbx/record/request/.

call_id.description: Unique call ID from the recording file name.

lifetime.description: Link lifetime in seconds (180 to 5184000, default 1800).

tools.name: zadarma_list_sms_templates
tools.title: List SMS templates
tools.description: List the SMS templates on the account, by category. Zadarma API: GET /v1/sms/templates/.

language.description: Template language, e.g. en. Default: the account language.

tools.name: zadarma_send_sms
tools.title: Send SMS
tools.description: Send an SMS to up to 10 phone numbers. This sends real messages and uses account balance; each send is billed. It is not retried, so check the result before sending again. Zadarma API: POST /v1/sms/send/.

numbers.description: Recipient phone numbers, digits with country code.

message.description: Message text. Long text is split into several SMS and billed per part.

sender.description: Sender: a virtual number or a text name (see the account's sender list).

language.description: Template language, if the message uses a template.
